paper_id: Zhang et al. - 2014 - Robust Trajectory Estimation for Crowdsourcing-Based Mobile Applications
title: Robust Trajectory Estimation for Crowdsourcing-Based Mobile Applications
venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
motivation: 众包数据含异常值导致轨迹估计不准确，影响室内定位等应用
problem_framing: 将异常数据问题形式化为鲁棒统计估计问题
key_insight: 众包数据提供冗余性可用于鲁棒估计；提出用户级鲁棒性以区分正常/异常用户
method_signature: TrMCD: 基于MCD估计器的鲁棒轨迹估计方法
evaluation_criteria: 映射误差(米)；对比LS和LV估计器
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 在大规模开放环境中可能失效（如大厅、博物馆）；方法受限于建筑类型
evidence_for_taste: data quality has not received sufficient attention
none of the proposed methods considered whether the estimated trajectories are robust
we propose to form a higher level concept of robustness based on users
no prior methods have been developed to deal with measurement errors in crowdsourcing from the robust statistical point of view
thinking_moves: 将定位问题重新框定为鲁棒估计问题
从点估计扩展到用户级鲁棒性
利用数据的统计冗余性克服空间分布不均衡
借鉴WSN鲁棒方法但针对多维轨迹数据的差异化建模
